boards.hardware: Paper V2 ESP32-S31NRV16, E0400A01-AF-S 4.0-inch monochrome panel, optional I2C touch on FPC2, ES8389, BQ27220, PCF85063, SC7A20
boards.identify: Paper V2 PCB with E0400A01-AF-S on FPC3 (24 pins); 528x792 portrait logical display
boards.flash_port: Type-C USB Serial/JTAG on GPIO33/34; hold BOOT (GPIO61) while connecting for download mode
boards.use: Independent touch/three-key WiFi desktop: offline nine-key/full-keyboard pinyin, Agent text/voice, conversations, alarm, calendar and SD music
boards.notes: Product ID 14, key paper-s31-4in0, chip_type esp32-s31. ESP-IDF 6.1. Shares Paper V2 peripheral drivers. KEY3 up, KEY2 down, KEY1 confirm; hold KEY1 back. BOOT has no app action. I2C touch auto-detects GT911/FT6x36/CST816; GT911 defaults to reversed 320x480 axes scaled to 528x792, with optional four-point calibration. Offline pinyin, 6763 GB2312 Hanzi; no handwriting. Layout v2 requires initial USB migration: future 3 MiB Factory, three 3 MiB app slots, shared raster/IME resources in font_cjk. Factory firmware is not implemented. Hardware/live platform acceptance pending. PCM16 voice; no S31 Opus library.
